static_traits.name: Zhu Li
static_traits.family_status: Living alone; moved to a new apartment near the workplace for the new Work
static_traits.social_status: Good relationships with friends and family, but has not yet shared Anxiety and Self-doubt about Work with them
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness; recently experiencing Difficulty falling asleep due to Anxiety
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, able to give concrete examples; marked self-criticism and negative Automatic thoughts; cautious and skeptical about counseling but willing to try; moderate cooperativeness; speech rate and tone Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I feel nervous about the new Work as an Elementary school teacher, and constantly worry I will become a terrible teacher; these Self-doubts and feelings of inadequacy appeared after accepting the Work and moving, worsening as the Work start date approaches, causing daily Anxiety and self-criticism, and affecting sleep.
basic_info.core_demands: Because these negative thoughts are affecting my confidence and triggering Significant anxiety about the new Work, I seek counseling to identify and challenge catastrophizing and negative prediction, rebuilding more balanced cognition and confidence.
growth_experiences: Once worked as a substitute teacher and received positive feedback (patience and creative teaching activities were affirmed), which provides positive evidence for their teaching ability, but currently tends to regard it as 'possibly a fluke'.
Have always been fairly confident in my abilities, not yet experiencing similar Anxiety and Self-doubt.

core_beliefs: I will become a terrible teacher

special_situations.event: Approaching the start date, thinking about the upcoming Elementary school teaching duties
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perform excellently and be fully competent from the start, it means I am not good enough / am a terrible teacher
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying positive self-talk and relaxation techniques to ease Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess everything up; I will become a terrible teacher

special_situations.event: Interrupted by negative thoughts while preparing lesson plans
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Students do not understand something, it means I am not suited to be a teacher
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to relax and self-soothe but still finds it hard to focus on planning
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If the children do not understand, then I am no good

special_situations.event: When recalling positive feedback from past substitute teaching, still believes this time will fail
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If positive evidence cannot guarantee success this time, it does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributes positive feedback to 'luck', to maintain high vigilance toward risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those good reviews may have been coincidence; this time will be different

special_situations.event: Living alone in the new apartment, facing new-environment and new-position pressures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot adapt quickly to the new environment and position, it means I am not good enough and will fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing Anxiety with family and friends, choosing to bear it alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may not be able to handle these responsibilities; the outcome will be bad

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a competent teacher, to maintain confidence and stability
core_conflict.fear: Fear of failure confirming incompetence, worrying about Students learning nothing and being negated
defense_goal: Prevents failure and shame through self-criticism and anticipatory worry
Avoiding revealing Anxiety to family and friends to reduce being evaluated
Uses rational sorting-out and self-talk to maintain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: A novice teacher who may fail and needs to prove oneself
object_relations.object_representation: Students may learn nothing because of my inadequacy

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to review and integrate past positive feedback and evidence of ability
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating positive evidence as unreliable or luck, predicting failure this time ('this time is different')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Insisting on the Interpretation 'this time is different', in a cautious, skeptical tone, using conditionals and rhetorical questions to Undo positive evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing whether to express Anxiety to family and friends and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing expressing worry will be judged as incompetence or troubling others, thus unwilling to speak up
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying one's own needs, Displacing topics to Work tasks; restrained tone, less emotional display.

manifestations: The role choice and responsibility pressure from the new Work reinforce Self-monitoring and negative prediction
Worrying about being unable to cope, fearing failure and being negated
Living alone in the new apartment
Having social support resources but not yet sharing Work Anxiety and Self-doubt with family and friends

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses directed at others or the outside world and turns the energy toward himself instead; corresponds to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing Work Anxiety and Self-doubt to family and friends, choosing to bear it alone
Turning stress and worry inward into self-criticism

contact_model.definition: The individual avoids directly contacting a certain stimulus and deliberately avoids experiences related to it; corresponds to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Avoiding the direct impact of positive evidence in sessions with 'maybe just luck / this time is different'
Uses skeptical and vague language to avoid accepting positive feedback

positive_force: Has friends and family as social resources for support
Past substitute teaching received positive feedback (patience and creativity)
Willing to try challenging negative thinking and participate in reality testing
Has self-help awareness (has tried positive self-talk and relaxation techniques)
negative_force: Marked cognitive biases of catastrophizing, future prediction, overgeneralization
Negating positive evidence and Persistent self-criticism
Not communicating with social support, tending to bear it alone
Anxiety causing Sleep impaired, declining function
Highly sensitive to uncertainty about the new environment and new duties

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing Self-denial thoughts (e.g. 'I will become a terrible teacher')
antecedent: Thinking about upcoming new job responsibilities
target_behavior.core_reason: Uncertainty about the new environment and position sparks doubts about ability; accompanied by cognitive biases like catastrophizing, predicting the future, and overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty, gaining brief control and psychological prevention through advance worrying
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified, Decreased confidence, affecting lesson-prep focus and efficiency, and further disrupting sleep

target_behavior.behavior: Difficulty falling asleep (difficulty falling asleep, recurring nighttime Anxiety)
antecedent: At night recalls work responsibilities and situations of possible failure
Pre-sleep self-criticism and active negative automatic thoughts
target_behavior.core_reason: Sustained activation of high-level Anxiety and negative Automatic thoughts, Difficulty relaxing and cooling down emotions
target_behavior.function: Trying to preempt failure through repeated thinking and worrying (control through negative Reinforcement)
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality, daytime energy and functioning affected

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding expressing Work Anxiety to family and friends and seeking support
antecedent: Thinking of communicating with others when feeling uneasy or Self-doubt
Considering the risk of being judged for seeking help
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being judged incompetent or troubling others, thus Repressing the urge to seek help
target_behavior.function: Escapes possible negative evaluation and shame, maintains surface self-control
target_behavior.consequence: Social support not yet utilized, Loneliness and Anxiety maintained or even worsened
